UnitAbilities.Title: Large Wings Adaptation
UnitAbilities.Text: This model gains the Flying special rule.

UnitAbilities.Title: Thick Carapace Adaptation
UnitAbilities.Text: This model has a Defence of 2+

Infos.Title: Unit Composition
Infos.Text: A Tyrant Clade unit consists of 1 Tyrant model. You may only include 1 Tyrant Clade unit in your army.

Infos.Title: Weapons and Equipment
Infos.Text: A Tyrant may be equipped with up to 3 weapons: Up to 1 from the Heavy Weapons list and up to 3 from the Standard Weapons or Specialist Weapons lists.

Infos.Title: Upgrades
Infos.Text: A Tyrant may take either the Large Wings Adaptation or Thick Carapace Adaption upgrade.

UnitAbilities.Title: Regeneration Adaptation
UnitAbilities.Text: At the start of every round, roll a d6 for this model. On a roll of 3+ it regenerates 1 lost hit point.

UnitAbilities.Title: Thick Carapace Adaptation
UnitAbilities.Text: This model has a Defence of 2+

UnitAbilities.Title: Psionic Urging
UnitAbilities.Text: Ability (1 Command Point): This model targets a friendly unit within 6 inches. That unit gains +1 Command Point, this may not take it's Command Points above it's initial value.

UnitAbilities.Title: Psionic Fury
UnitAbilities.Text: Ability (1 Command Point): This model targets a friendly unit within 6 inches. At the end of this models activation the targeted unit may make a free Attack action, however any weapon used gains the Volatile special rule for that attack.

UnitAbilities.Title: Psionic Regeneration
UnitAbilities.Text: Friendly models within 6 inches of this model gain +1 to their Counter rolls and may never have their Defence Rolls lowered below a 6+.

Infos.Title: Unit Composition
Infos.Text: A Psionic Queen unit consists of 1 Psionic Queen models. You may only include 1 Psionic Queen in you army.

Infos.Title: Weapons and Equipment
Infos.Text: A Psionic Queen must be equipped with a Neural Blast or a Psionic Blast and must also take Razor Claws.

Infos.Title: Upgrades
Infos.Text: A Psionic Queen must choose 2 or 3 of the following upgrades: Regeneration Adaptation, Thick Carapace Adaptation, Psionic Urging, Psionic Fury, or Psionic Regeneration.

UnitAbilities.Title: Swift Adaptation
UnitAbilities.Text: This model gains +3 to it's Movement attribute.

UnitAbilities.Title: Stealth Adaptation
UnitAbilities.Text: This model gains the Stealth 12 special rule.

Infos.Title: Unit Composition
Infos.Text: A Drone Clade unit consists of 8-16 Drone models.

Infos.Title: Weapons and Equipment
Infos.Text: Each Drone must be equipped with the same weapon. Drones may be equipped with 1 or 2 weapons from the Standard Weapons list.

Infos.Title: Upgrades
Infos.Text: Every Drone may be upgraded with the Swift Adaptation or the Stealth Adaptation.

UnitAbilities.Title: Ferocity Adaptation
UnitAbilities.Text: This model gains the Skilled special rule.

Infos.Title: Unit Composition
Infos.Text: A Warrior Clade unit consists of between 3 and 6 Warrior models. You may include 1 Warrior Clade unit for every Drone Clade unit in your army.

Infos.Title: Weapons and Equipment
Infos.Text: Each Warrior model must be equipped with the same weapons. You may select up to 2 weapons from the Standard Weapons and Specialist Weapons. 1 Warrior may instead select one of its weapons from the Heavy Weapons list.

Infos.Title: Upgrades
Infos.Text: Every Warrior model may be given the Ferocity Adaptation upgrade.

UnitAbilities.Title: Swift Adaptation
UnitAbilities.Text: This model gains +3 to it's Movement attribute.

UnitAbilities.Title: Stealth Adaptation
UnitAbilities.Text: This model gains the Stealth 12 special rule.

UnitAbilities.Title: Armour Adaptation
UnitAbilities.Text: This model gains the Resilient special rule.

Infos.Title: Unit Composition
Infos.Text: An Adaptive Drone Clade unit consists of 8-16 Adaptive Drone models.

Infos.Title: Weapons and Equipment
Infos.Text: Each Adaptive Drone must be equipped with the same weapon. Adaptive Drones may be equipped with 1 or 2 weapons from the Standard Weapons or Specialist Weapons lists.

Infos.Title: Upgrades
Infos.Text: Every Adaptive Drone may be upgraded with the Swift Adaptation, Stealth Adaptation, or Armour Adaptation upgrade.

UnitAbilities.Title: Regeneration Adaptation
UnitAbilities.Text: At the start of every round, roll a d6 for this model. On a roll of 3+ it regenerates 1 lost hit point.

Infos.Title: Unit Composition
Infos.Text: A Brute Clade unit consists of 1 Brute model.

Infos.Title: Weapons and Equipment
Infos.Text: A Brute may select 1 weapon from the Heavy Weapons list and up to 2 weapons from the Standard Weapons and Specialist Weapons lists.

Infos.Title: Upgrades
Infos.Text: This model may take the Regenerative Adaptation upgrade.

ArmyRules.Title: About The Swarm
ArmyRules.Text: Driven by an unknowable intelligence to expand their territory and eradicate all other life, the creatures of the Swarm are an ever present threat.

ArmyRules.Title: Building an Army
ArmyRules.Text:
Building your army for Fracture is simple, players agree a maximum number of points then choose their units from a suitable army list, ensuring the total points cost for their models, weapons, and equipment don't exceed that maximum. Each army list is designed to reflect a certain type of faction rather than one single entity, choose the one that best suits your chosen miniatures and play style.

In addition to the maximum points each player can spend there are also 3 categories of unit; Command, Standard, and Specialist. An army must be at least 25% (by points) Standard models, no more than 25% Command models, and no more than 50% Specialist models.

Recommended points for games of Fracture are 500-1000 points for smaller games which can be played on a 3ft by 4ft battlefield and up to 2000 for larger games with a larger battlefield.

ArmyRules.Title: Roster Restrictions
ArmyRules.Text: Check the source Unit Composition and Weapons and Equipment notes when building an army. Army category percentages, one-per-army limits across variants, transport ratios, unique weapons, and matching equipment or upgrades across squad models require manual checking.
